a.name: Route line
a.description: Claims as stops on a transit-map line from the parents in Carlisle to a London door; vertical on phones, ruled top and bottom.
a.differs_from: The claims are joined in order on one route line under its own question heading; the built strips are flat single or double columns.

b.name: Seal band
b.description: Six promises as brass-ringed seals with two-line labels across a full-width steel band.
b.differs_from: A six-across seal grid on a steel band; the built trust strips are one or two columns, plain or carded, never on a band.

c.name: Photo ledger
c.description: A card with a photo of Maggie, the dam, and her puppies left; a question heading and a two-column ledger of icon claims right.
c.differs_from: The only trust strip with a photo, and its claims form a two-column ledger beside it; the built strips carry no image and no heading.
